scope: Host Mesa RTV4 replay of production-generated sampled records; conditional raster comparison, not independent native geometry, saved-note, device, or arbitrary-transform parity.
inputs: pressure_ramp ARGB 80336699 tilt 0.4 then channel_baseline ARGB ffdd4411 tilt 0.8; top-left origin, scale 2, translations [6,-7] and [9,-9], nonuniform premultiplied RGBA prior with alpha 128.
results: Rust canvas, resvg and freshly built Node WASM match native RGBA exactly.

pdf_white_composite.method: 72 dpi RGB against native premultiplied RGB plus 255 minus alpha
pdf_white_composite.note: Differences include untouched prior pixels; reader compositing/transport is not exact for this translucent control.

commands: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/sdocx-agent-target CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo build -p sdocx-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
fresh_wasm.paths_note: Paths describe this run; another environment may use a different matching wasm-bindgen 0.2.114 installation and output directory.
